description: Get the HTML of a page shared as HTML, exactly as it was uploaded, so you can make the changes reviewers asked for and publish the result with update_page. Call it before editing when you don't already have the page's code in this conversation. Defaults to the latest version. Pages over about 400 KB come back in parts: call again with the next_offset it gives. For a live website it returns the site's current HTML for reference only, since the site is changed in its own code or builder. PDFs have no HTML.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

offset.description: Optional. Where to start, for a big page: the next_offset from the previous call. Default 0.

version.description: Optional. The version to read, as shown by list_versions. Default: the latest.

name: get_page_html
title: Read a page's HTML
